description: FICTURN lets users browse and read short, finished fiction directly inside ChatGPT. The current library includes romantic suspense, uncanny horror, and near-future speculative fiction, presented in an inline reader with progress, Previous and Continue navigation, and a Library view. FICTURN serves fixed story text and does not generate or rewrite the prose on the fly.

defaultPrompt: Show me a short story I can read in 5 minutes
Give me a romantic suspense story
